description: LIMITATION PIN (not a merge defect). A `do`-`while` loop - the first in the corpus. As with for_loop the merge is clean and the affected points are right, but Joern's code string for the structure is the literal `do {...} while (n < 20)` - a placeholder, not source - so emission's `code { ... }` shape produces nonsense. Emitting it correctly needs the `do { body } while (cond);` shape reconstructed rather than copied. Pinned; XPASS retires it.
